meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 接入 GitHub 频道：有人在 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 机器人账号时，它在评论线程里回复，并继续跟随后续评论。
howto.when: 当有人在 PR 或 issue 评论中 @ 机器人账号时触发；需先创建专用机器人账号、令牌和 webhook 才能接入。

say.text: 帮我在项目里加 GitHub 频道
say.note: 会从 channels 分支复制适配器并注册

say.text: 把 PR 和 issue 评论接到我的 agent
say.note: 每个 PR/issue 独立会话

say.text: 给 owner/repo 建频道，用 strict 策略

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude gets a GitHub channel: when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment, it replies in that comment thread and keeps answering follow-up comments.
howto.when_en: Fires when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment; setup needs a dedicated bot account, a fine-grained token and a repo webhook.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel to my project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter from the channels branch

say_en.text: Wire PR and issue comments to my agent
say_en.note: Each PR or issue gets its own session

say_en.text: Create a channel for owner/repo with strict policy
say_en.note: Only registered members can trigger it
